text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Training with the support AI Three 
Goddesses in a virtual space using the VR 
Umalator— This happened during a short 
break.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh~! Just taking a quick breather, 
but... Man, this is picture-perfect nap 
weather~.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, stretching out like that makes you 
look just like my cat. ...Would you like 
to rest on my lap?

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
...Do not pamper her so much. She will get 
carried away and become unmanageable.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Come on, what's wrong with doing it during 
break time? So cold~. —Waaah waaah, I am 
so sad, Byerley.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... What are you even doing? Have 
some self-awareness of being called "Three 
Goddesses"—

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Waaah waaah. Why are you fighting~? Please 
get along, everyone...

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Wha! Godolphin, not you too...!? Stop it, 
this is getting out of hand...

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
...Fine, I get it! I will give you walnuts 
later! I'll give them to you, so stop 
crying! Smile! Maintain your dignity!
